correctness.rationale: For every n≥3 the rightmost corank-two factor has one uniformly chosen upper hook. Exactly two of the r through endpoints lie on this hook with probability r(r−1)/[n(n−1)], giving a rank drop by exactly two and no other possibility. The S_n×S_n two-sided unit action is transitive on each rank class, and the product measure is bi-invariant, so each target of rank r is equiprobable. The rational generating-function recurrence gives all finite product fibers; geometric waiting times prove exact absorption and harmonic expectations; finite-rank truncation proves the parity-separated scaled limit. The included perfect-matching checker reproduces every output fiber at n=3,4 through length 4 and at n=5 through length 2, checks hook rank transitions at n=6, and normalizes laws at 3≤n<20. The proof, rather than finite experiments, establishes unrestricted n,k.

value.rationale: The full corank-two class is the natural first singular Green class of the Brauer monoid; its products generate the singular ideal. Determining every fixed-target structure constant at all product lengths is a motivated multiplication invariant, strictly finer than ideal generation and rank-stratum cardinalities. The identified discrete pairwise-merger mechanism yields sharp parity-sensitive quadratic absorption profiles and exact total-variation distances, visibly different from the deletion-set processes of partial permutation monoids. The coalescent waiting-time theory itself is credited as existing input.
